Corollary
[Noncollapsing (Corollary 27.49)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0050 ↗ thm:chow-iv-sharp-log-sobolev 1. ch27:27.49\group Shrinker geometry at infinity

A complete noncompact shrinker is $\kappa $-noncollapsed at scales where $R\le r^{-2}$, with $\kappa $ depending only on its entropy constant.
